🔥 Ethan says it at the fire, not quite looking at Brian: “Your past story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.
“You’re right.” Brian doesn’t look up. “I wasn’t Denver. I was Nairobi, Kenya. I’m sorry — I wanted a cleaner story than I had.” The fire lets it land. Someone passes Brian the bowl without a word.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
